status: Review prototype: consult current validation and service reports; physical fit, strength and force unvalidated

parts.name: shaft_cap
parts.supports: Option A flush-T: common X12 exterior face down (+90 degrees about Y); wings and collar face share the bed plane. Slicer/support review still required; no support-free claim.

parts.name: carrier
parts.supports: Carrier without actuator rail; export orientation provisional. Compare cut-end-on-bed to protect neck mating surfaces; inspect track roofs and accessible support removal.

parts.name: sliding_jaw
parts.supports: Compact jaw; export orientation provisional. Inspect tongue, ledge and hooks for overhangs; protect sliding faces and minimize removable supports.

parts.name: phone_cuff
parts.supports: Exact enlarged cuff, flat back down. PETG prototype approved; TPU 95A intended. Historical cuff-only slice is not a complete-jaw print plan.

parts.name: actuator_bracket
parts.supports: Common flat Y5.4 back face down (-90 degrees about X). Outer pulley cheek/arm and raised plinth removed; remaining boss raised 2 mm. Extended curved guide and independent return stop. Fresh slice required; support savings and cantilever strength unqualified.

parts.name: plunger
parts.supports: Rounded shoe and cleat need slice review; keep supports off guide surfaces.

parts.name: pulley
parts.supports: Axis vertical, flange on bed. Keep bore and cord groove clean; running clearance unvalidated.

parts.name: pulley_axle
parts.supports: No thread. Head-down orientation provisional; cross-key slot needs slice review.

parts.name: pulley_key
parts.supports: Flat cross-key; preserve square load faces and band seats. Orientation provisional.

parts.name: thumb_screw
parts.supports: Head on bed; no support in threads. Fit trial first; do not force.

parts.name: collar_screw
parts.supports: Head on bed; longer 8×3 profile, flush tip. New grip length requires fit and loaded tests.

parts.name: thumb_nut
parts.supports: Flat on bed; no supports. Fit trial first.

parts.name: string_guide
parts.supports: Eye translated to saddle edge; eye and saddle lower faces coplanar on bed. Verify support-free slice.

parts.name: dual_string_guide
parts.supports: Both eyes translated to saddle edge without rotation; lower faces coplanar on bed, central band lane clear. Verify support-free slice.
